lines.text: Marciana points her gun at Mori.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: H-huh? What the heck?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Wh-what's going on?!
*Click*
Grave and Cinderella immediately assume combat stances.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Did... she just fly?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: And those weapons... what exactly are they?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Starting with threats? How uncouth.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Who exactly are you?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Lower your weapon.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: A-ah... Wait, you guys!
The bubbles around Little Mermaid begin to shake erratically.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: What's that supposed to be...?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: As I suspected... this is part of the test, isn't it?
Marciana uneasily examines Little Mermaid and Cinderella's equipment.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Please answer me.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Are you examiners sent by the school for our graduation exam?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Or are you the targets we're supposed to take down?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I require a more detailed explanation.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: ... Graduation exam? Examiners?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I haven't the faintest idea what you're talking about.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Lower your weapon.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: This is your final warning.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Um, Miss Marciana.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Stay back, Naga.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'll protect all of you,

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: no matter what happens.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: But look at the way they're dressed.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Their clothing? Why bring that up all of a sudden...?
Only then does Marciana realize what Cinderella's group is wearing.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... Swimsuits?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Maybe they just came to have fun at the beach?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Going to the surface just to play in the ocean in swimsuits?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That's absurd.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: But isn't that what we came here for?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Th-that's...
The sound of footsteps draws closer.
We're ba...

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Commander, look over there.
Wait... Marciana? Tia? Naga?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... Commander?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Teacher!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Wowww!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: It's Teacher!
Marciana quickly steps in front of Tia, stopping her before she can run over to me.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Wait, I need to check something first.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Miss Marciana...?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Commander, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You're not involved in this exam too, are you?
Wait a sec, what are you talking about?
No, more importantly, how'd you guys end up here...?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: You know Prince?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Prince?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Just one of the Commander's many nicknames.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Oh, you meant the Commander. Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: But what are you doing here?
I briefly fill Marciana in on how we ended up here.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Then who exactly are these people?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: They seem to be using some rather unusual equipment.
Marciana eyes Cinderella and the others suspiciously.
I quickly come up with a plausible excuse.
They're a special unit under my command.
That's why they use some nonstandard gear.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: We can't tell you anything beyond that. It's classified.
My eyes meet Cinderella's.
She gives me a reassuring smile before stepping forward.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I'm Cinderella.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I use a weapon called Glass Slippers.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: It can fire high-output beams in dozens of different modes.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Since the surface is reflective, I can use it as a mirror when needed.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: And yes, it can fly too.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: High-output beams... and now flight too...?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I am Grave.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm Mori.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: I'm Little Mermaid, but you can just call me Siren.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: This is the liquid metal I use. It's called bubbles.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: It can change shape however I want, and since it's easy to control, it's incredibly versatile.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: ... Though it's a little unstable right now.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Aw, that's pretty. Look how sparkly it is.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Right? Right? Isn't it amazing?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I understand now.
Marciana bows her head in apology.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I apologize for being rude when we first met.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I let my emotions get the better of me while trying to protect my students.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I should introduce myself. My name is Marciana.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'm a teacher at M.M.R. Vocational School in the Ark.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: These are my students. They're all in their graduating year.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Hi there, I'm Tia! Hope we get along well!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I'm Naga. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: There's a school for Nikkes?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: ... Yes, that's correct.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You weren't aware of that?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I had no idea.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: If you're from the Ark, you should already know that.
Marciana gives Cinderella another suspicious look.
Actually, they've got their reasons, so they don't really know much about how things work in the Ark.
Just keep that in mind.
Come to think of it, Mori, you already knew that, right?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: O-of course, I do...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll explain...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: M.M.R. Vocational School is a Nikke training school sponsored by M.M.R.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: They say the students get to learn and grow in the best educational environment their researchers can create...

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: A Nikke training school... How fascinating.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: So that's why you were talking about exams and examiners earlier.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: I wonder what it's like there.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I bet they offer all kinds of classes...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You need not envy them.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: We can train in all sorts of ways too.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Y-yeah, you're right!

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Come to think of it, how did you all end up here?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'm on a graduation trip with Naga and Tia

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: since they're graduating this year.
... A graduation trip?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Yep! The school sent us on a graduation trip, so Miss Marciana, Tia, and I ended up here together.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: This actually wasn't where we were supposed to go, but we got caught up in some weird whirlpool on the way.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: The boat we came on got wrecked,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: and we somehow made it here!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Then you suddenly popped up outta nowhere, Teacher! I'm so happy, hehe.
Wait, your school actually sent you guys on a graduation trip?
Seriously?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Mm-hmm!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: They said once we get back from our graduation trip, we'll finally get to graduate!
When I look toward Marciana, she leans in and whispers.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: To be honest...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I'm still not really sure

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: whether this is actually a trip or just another test.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I mean, we ended up stranded on this island instead of the one we were supposed to go to...
Hmm...

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Commander, you really don't know anything?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: The people you're with don't exactly seem ordinary.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: You weren't brought here as an examiner again, were you?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: What if this whole situation is some kind of test...?
No.
Like I said before, we just ended up here by chance.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: What are you two whispering about?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I-it's nothing.
Come to think of it, you said your boat got wrecked, right?
So I guess you can't get to the island you were originally headed to?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: That's correct.
I'd like to lend you our boat, but we've only got one.
And with that whirlpool surrounding the island, it'll be hard to leave for now.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: We think that the whirlpool is somehow connected to this island,

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: so we were just about to explore the island ourselves.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: It'd be good if you helped us too,

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: since it doesn't seem like you have any other options.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Yes, we'll help.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Let's do our best together.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Yes, likewise.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Do you all have your swimsuits?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: We did bring them, but...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Then go get changed.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Rapi said going to the beach without a swimsuit is like heading into battle without ammo.
Rapi nods and gives me a thumbs-up.
Seriously, why does she keep looking at me whenever she does that...?

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: I... I see.

lines.speaker: marciana
lines.text: Then this is serious. We'll go change right away.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Naga, let's go get changed together!

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Sure, I'll help you with your swimsuit.
The three of them head off to get changed.
